text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused on assessing soil erosion and soil conservation status at a national scale (Portugal). The primary objective is to develop a methodology to identify areas needing land degradation neutrality plans based on soil erosion, soil quality, and land use. It does not focus on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation, nor does it implement multiple future scenarios with quantitative comparison of LULC projections. Although it uses land use maps and scenarios of C-factor values, these are used for soil cover protection assessment rather than for predicting or simulating future LULC changes. The study lacks spatial modeling of future LULC changes, accuracy metrics on LULC predictions, or mapped future LULC projections. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria related to LULC prediction.)
